doc_pages.title: Getting started with 1145 Lifestyle
doc_pages.summary: What you will need and what to expect once the first module is released.
doc_pages.body:
## Current status

1145 Lifestyle is in development. There is no public web app or store listing yet, so there is nothing to install or open.

## What you will need

- A phone or computer with an internet connection. Supported devices will be confirmed with the first release.
- A 1145 Lifestyle account. You will create it on the product's own domain or in its official app, never on this website.

## When a release is published

1. Open the [1145 Lifestyle product page](/work/1145).
2. Check the status and the platform you want to use.
3. Use the **Open** or **Download** button. It will only appear for a release LSI has reviewed and published.

Account setup, onboarding and payment or wallet guidance will be added here only for capabilities that have actually been released.

doc_pages.summary: The marketplace, merchant, delivery, ride and financial modules, and the current availability of each.
doc_pages.body:
1145 Lifestyle is made up of modules. Each one is released and documented separately. Every module below is currently **planned**. None has been released.

## Marketplace

For consumers. Browse products from participating merchants, place orders and follow them through to delivery.

## Merchant tools

For merchants and brand owners. List products, manage stock and orders, and see how a store is performing.

## Delivery

For delivery partners. Assign, track and complete deliveries for marketplace orders.

## Rides

For consumers and drivers. Request and manage rides through the same account.

## Financial services

For consumers and merchants. Wallet and payment features related to shopping on the platform. No financial service is live, and guidance will be published only for services that have been released and approved.

doc_pages.title: Analysis views
doc_pages.summary: What the macro-regime, daily-bias, market-structure, liquidity, regression and Double Bollinger Bands views are meant to show.
doc_pages.body:
Every view is planned. This page explains the intent of each one so that its output can be read critically.

## Macro regime

A summary of the wider economic conditions that tend to influence gold. It gives context. It does not predict price.

## Daily bias

A stated directional lean for the day, shown with the inputs that produced it so you can judge whether you agree.

## Market structure

The current trend, recent swing highs and lows, and the points where structure has changed.

## Liquidity

Price areas where resting orders are likely to cluster. These are estimates drawn from price history, not a view of an order book.

## Regression

Where price sits relative to a regression line fitted to its recent trend, and how far it has stretched from it.

## Double Bollinger Bands

Two sets of Bollinger Bands at different widths, used together to describe momentum and range.

## Reading the views together

The views can disagree. Disagreement is information, not an error, and no single view should be treated as a signal on its own.

pages.title: About LSI Corp
pages.description: Technology, logistics and finance connected around real-world commerce.
pages.body:
Founded in 2016, Lifestyle Investment Corp (LSI) works across technology, logistics and finance. LSI designs smart, scalable solutions that connect digital platforms, efficient logistics networks and secure financial systems.

## Our mission

To simplify and enable commerce. By connecting innovation with practical execution, LSI helps businesses move goods, transact with confidence and build for sustainable growth in an increasingly digital economy.

## How LSI creates value

**Connected design.** LSI brings digital services, operational workflows and financial tools together, so that each part supports the wider customer and business journey.

**Practical execution.** Products are shaped around everyday needs: finding and selling goods, arranging delivery, accessing media and understanding markets.

**Scalable foundations.** LSI focuses on systems that can grow across users, merchants, partners and new service areas over time.

## At a glance

- **Founded:** 2016
- **Core focus:** technology, logistics and finance
- **Approach:** integrated platforms and real-world delivery
- **Purpose:** make commerce simpler, more connected and easier to scale

## Our work

LSI's portfolio applies technology to distinct needs: connected commerce, media playback, spoken-audio publishing and listening, and market research. The projects are at different stages of definition and development, and each is shown with its true status.

See [what we do](/services), browse [our work](/work) or [get in touch](/contact).

pages.title: Accessibility statement
pages.description: How this website supports accessibility and how to report a problem.
pages.body:
LSI Corp wants this website to be usable by as many people as possible. Our target is the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2, level AA.

## What we have done

- Every control can be reached and used with a keyboard, with a visible focus indicator.
- Status is always written in words and never shown by colour alone.
- Text and controls are designed to meet AA contrast in light and dark colour schemes.
- The site does not play audio or video automatically and does not rely on animation.
- Download buttons name their platform and version.

## Known limitations

This website is an application drawn inside the browser rather than a set of standard web pages. Because of that:

- Screen reader support depends on your browser and may be incomplete.
- Browser features such as find-in-page, text zoom and reader mode may not work as they do on ordinary pages.
- The first visit needs a larger download than a typical web page.

A short plain-text summary of the site is shown if the application cannot start.

## Reporting a problem

If something on this site is not accessible to you, please tell us through [the contact page](/contact).

pages.title: Privacy notice
pages.description: What this website collects and how it is used.
pages.body:
This notice covers the LSI Corp website only. Each product in our portfolio has its own privacy information, linked from its page once the product is released.

## What this website collects

- **Browsing the site.** You do not need an account. The website does not use advertising or cross-site tracking, and sets no cookies for visitors.
- **The contact form.** If you send us an enquiry, we receive what you enter: your name, your email address, your organisation if you give one, the service you are asking about and your message. We use it only to reply to you and to handle your enquiry. You are asked to agree to this before sending.
- **Staff sign-in.** If you are a member of LSI staff and sign in, your sign-in session is stored in your browser so that you stay signed in.
- **Technical logs.** The services that host this website and its content may keep standard technical logs, such as IP address and time of request, to keep the service secure and working.

Do not put passwords, payment details or other sensitive information in the contact form.

## Who can see an enquiry

Only LSI staff. Enquiries are not published and are not shared with other organisations.

## Asking us to remove your details

Tell us through the [contact page](/contact) and we will delete your enquiry.

## Links to other sites

Download and launch buttons can take you to an app store or to a product's own domain. Those links are labelled, and the destination's own privacy terms apply once you leave.

## Changes

If this notice changes, the review date shown on this page is updated.

pages.title: Terms of use
pages.description: The terms for using this website.
pages.body:
These terms cover the LSI Corp website. Each product has its own terms and licence, shown with its releases.

## Information on this site

LSI aims to keep product status, documentation and release details accurate. Products marked In Development or Coming Soon are not available, and planned features may change or may not be released.

## Downloads

Only use downloads and links published on this website. Check the version, platform and compatibility details before installing. For direct file downloads, compare the published SHA-256 checksum with the file you received.

## Market analysis

Where a product provides market research or analysis, that analysis is not financial advice and does not guarantee returns.
